queries_run: Oscar Health regulation OR regulatory scrutiny ACA marketplace 2026
OSCR Oscar Health antitrust OR DOJ OR FTC investigation 2026

findings.claim: 10-K 風險因素：Oscar 因收取聯邦付款，受 DOJ／HHS-OIG／CMS 的詐欺、浪費與濫用法規（含 FCA）管轄，預期持續受審查；10-K 未點名具體反壟斷調查。
findings.excerpt: We anticipate continued scrutiny by the HHS-OIG and the DOJ in the areas of fraud, waste, and abuse, including the use of telehealth and telemedicine-based treatment, and we may be subject to audits, reviews and investigations of our telehealth coverage and payment practices and arrangements by government agencies.

findings.claim: 10-K 風險因素：部分市場的醫院或醫師團體具near monopoly地位，削弱 Oscar 議價力（供給端集中，非 Oscar 自身被調查）。
findings.excerpt: In some markets and geographies, certain healthcare providers, particularly hospitals, physician/hospital organizations, or multi-specialty physician groups, may have significant positions or near monopolies that could result in diminished bargaining power on our part during contract negotiations.

findings.claim: 搜尋未發現 2026 年針對 Oscar 的 DOJ／FTC／EU 反壟斷調查或拆分風險；產業監管面向為 eAPTC 補貼 2025 年底到期、CMS 2025 年 Program Integrity 規則（部分條款遭 Maryland 聯邦地院 2025-08-22 暫停）。依 Q2 2026 10-Q 摘要，公司業務受州與聯邦監管機關審查。
2019 年 Oscar 為原告控告 Florida Blue 排他經紀人政策，DOJ 提出支持 Oscar 的利益聲明；地院判 Oscar 敗訴後上訴第 11 巡迴法院。
findings.source: Fierce Healthcare: DOJ sides with Oscar Health in ongoing spat with Florida Blue

regulatory_antitrust.note: Oscar 2019 年曾以反壟斷控告 Florida Blue（Oscar 為原告，一審敗訴後上訴），現況未查證；未進一步搜尋。 線索 1 條，程式核實 0 條，1 條以搜尋摘要保留（未核原文）
